title: Change the target

predict.q: The managers of the firm in the worked example switch from maximising profit to maximising sales revenue. Compared with the profit-maximising choice, they will:

options.s: Produce more and charge a lower price
options.fb: Revenue peaks where MR = 0, at Q = 12: more than 8, at a lower price (12 instead of 16), with less profit (30 instead of 54).

options.s: Produce the same and charge more
options.fb: The firm can only sell more at a lower price (AR slopes down). Revenue is highest at Q = 12, not at Q = 8.

options.s: Produce less and charge a higher price
options.fb: Less output means a higher price, but at Q = 8 MR is still positive (8), so more units raise revenue.

options.s: Produce more and charge a higher price
options.fb: Along a downward-sloping AR curve, more output and a higher price cannot happen together.

task: Move the **output** slider from 8 to 14 and watch TR, profit, price and the AR and AC curves.

target.do: Move the output slider to where TR is highest (MR = 0), then press Check.

takeaway: Revenue peaks where MR = 0 and sales volume peaks where AR = AC; both mean more output, a lower price and less profit.
